findings.motion: San Diego Unified board item on safe gun storage (Gun Violence Prevention Week); joint announcement with City Attorney and Superintendent on the city's firearm safe storage ordinance
findings.note: A district news release says that as board vice president he would join the superintendent and city attorney to announce a joint effort to reduce gun violence and inform families of the city's safe storage law for firearms, ahead of a board discussion of safe gun storage. The release is the district's text, not his own words; the year is inferred from the Feb. 11 Tuesday meeting and the release's 2020 context.
